# Independent related-text DOCX fixtures

`baseline.docx` and `changed.docx` are actual LibreOffice Writer exports from
original authored Flat ODF XML. Generate with `python3 test/docx-related-independent-produce.py`.
Producer: LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0, commit
2c87e51eeaa2b413ff4ae097b2705eea1995d8e5, 2026-10-23.
The authored sources include two master-page sections, headers/footers, a footnote
and endnote. Baseline and changed have identical body text; only four related
stories change. LibreOffice emits first-section default references, second-section
default and blank first variants, and separator/continuation note records.

`renumbered`, `moved-reference`, `repeated-reference`, and `inherited` are explicitly
**derived XML package mutations**, generated by
`python3 test/docx-related-independent-derive.py`. They are not claimed to be
unmodified office-producer outputs. The derivation uses Python ZIP/XML tools and
asserts source story text against independently authored expected.json.

Qualification concerns logical relationship/story association, not rendered page
pagination or whether first/even variants appear on any particular page. The
extractor never supplies the fixture expected text. These fixtures do not prove
Microsoft Word-produced interoperability.
